
DAY-TO-DAY LAUNCH OPTIONS (everything the binary accepts: --help-advanced; resolved values: --print-config)

  launch flags (read at boot)
    --default-presence-penalty <value>
    --max-batch <value>
    --max-tokens <value>
    --model-dir <value>
    --node
    --port <value>
    --prefix-cache <value>
    --server
    --thinking <value>
    --tp

  SERVING
    --exit-on-fatal <on|off>           sticky CUDA error / scheduler panic: exit 70 so a supervisor restarts (default; off = engine DEAD, /health 503)  [on]
    --host <TEXT>                      HTTP API bind address: an IPv4/IPv6 address or a host name (e.g. 127.0.0.1 = this machine only). 0.0.0.0 (default) = every interface  [0.0.0.0]
    --kv-spill <PATH>                  SSD spill tier: when a new conversation takes over a lane that holds another one, save the old conversation's prompt state to disk and restore it when it returns (only when the disk read beats re-reading the prompt; text only). Default off (owner decision 2026-10-23). A snapshot carries only the rows the conversation uses plus the recurrent state (about 80 MB per machine for a 4K-token conversation at TP=4). auto = on, in /tmp/gb10_kv_spill; a directory = on, there; off = no tier. Under TP every machine writes its own share and the machines agree on every save and restore  [off]
    --log-level <normal|debug>         boot output: normal = lean uniform report (stage lines + one SERVING line + warnings/errors/notices); debug = everything the boot printed before OUT1, verbatim, plus the new lines  [normal]
    --max-seq-len <N>                  max context / KV depth (the DSV4 TP paths honour it as the override)  [per mode]
    --scrub-tool-secrets <off|provenance|pattern|all>
                                       server (TOOLSCRUB1, opt-in hardening): redact tool-result-derived secrets from SERVED text only - streamed SSE deltas and non-streaming bodies: reasoning_content, content and tool-call arguments; the model's own context is never modified and the tool-call parser still sees raw text. off (default) = no served byte changes, zero cost. provenance = redact echoes of credential-shaped strings that appeared in THIS conversation's tool results (exact + width-10 shingle matches; [redacted:tool-secret]). pattern = redact key-shaped text anywhere (sk-, AKIA, gh[pousr]_, JWT shape, hex runs of 16+ digits incl. UUID/IPv6 shapes, high-entropy runs; [redacted:key-shape]). all = both layers. Redactions are counted on /metrics as velogb10_scrub_hits_total. Deployers serving agentic traffic where tool results carry credentials may want this on; the engine imposes no system prompt (D3 rejected 2026-10-13)  [off]

  SPECULATION
    --mtp <auto|on|off>                Multi-token (MTP) speculative decoding. off = plain decoding only, on every server: no draft head runs and the boot banner says 'MTP OFF (--mtp off)' (the EXL3 server of v0.7.3 and earlier ignored this option). auto (default) = speculation on with the profitability control (NVFP4: calibrated at boot and re-picked live; EXL3: the per-request auto-off and re-probe). on = force it (NVFP4, benchmarking; on EXL3 the same as auto). Greedy verification is lossless (a draft is kept only when it is the model's own next token) and sampled requests stay distribution-exact. Older spellings still accepted: 1 / true = on, 0 / false = off, and the EXL3-only --exl3-no-mtp = off. Rides to the TP nodes  [auto]

  913 further options (diagnostics, test drills, probes, tunables): --help-advanced.   Resolved values: --print-config.

  A value that really starts with "--" must be written --option=value; a value-taking option is never taken from the next --flag - no value-taking option, registry or hand-read, ever eats one (F7/F9).
